correctness.rationale: Cubic edge-count inequality 2k>=8+e(S) forces minimum k>=4 and independence/equivalent induced-tree structure at k=4. Read RESULT.md and both direct_check.js and cycle_check.js Git blobs. Independent graph generation, union-find complete enumeration and all-source BFS confirmed GP(5,2): 20 optimal triples all slides frozen; GP(6,2): 120 optimal 4-sets connected slides; GP(7,2): 70 optimal 4-sets, slide 14K1+14K2+7P4 (35 edges), jump 4-regular, 140 edges, eccentricities 56 at 6 and 14 at 7. This is full finite enumeration, not a theorem for n>=8.
